summary: Solflare posted a limited-time Charizard and Fire Friends pack, and it was our best post in the scan (124 likes, 26 replies). Replies were mostly fun, with a couple of people unhappy about bad pulls. Moonshot's Jupiter gacha is still pushing hard with creators and free daily packs until 24 Nov, and one post says packs are now a commodity so the fight is about keeping users. On the mainstream side, Walmart's Pokémon draw ran again, which shows how hard it still is to get product at retail.
